name: fortigate-cloud
label: FortiGate Cloud
description: FortiGate Cloud is a cloud-based management platform for FortiGate devices. This connector facilitates automated operations to retrieve and add devices provisioned to FortiGate Cloud, manage their configuration backup and report schedules, proxy FortiOS API calls to a managed FortiGate through FortiGate Cloud, and run curated FortiOS proxy operations on a managed FortiGate, including blocking and unblocking IP addresses.

operations.title: Call FortiOS API
operations.description: Proxies a FortiOS API call to a managed FortiGate through FortiGate Cloud. The FortiGate must be deployed to FortiGate Cloud with configuration management enabled and its management tunnel online. Only the GET method is available on free FortiGate Cloud accounts; the POST, PUT and DELETE methods require a paid FortiGate.

parameters.title: Serial Number
parameters.description: Specify the serial number of the FortiGate provisioned to FortiGate Cloud.
parameters.tooltip: Specify the serial number of the FortiGate provisioned to FortiGate Cloud.

parameters.name: method
parameters.title: Method
parameters.description: Select the HTTP method of the FortiOS API call. POST, PUT and DELETE require a paid FortiGate.
parameters.tooltip: Select the HTTP method of the FortiOS API call. POST, PUT and DELETE require a paid FortiGate.

parameters.name: fos_api_path
parameters.title: FortiOS API Path
parameters.description: Specify the FortiOS API path to call, for example: api/v2/monitor/license/status. Refer to the FortiOS API documentation for available paths.
parameters.tooltip: Specify the FortiOS API path to call, for example: api/v2/monitor/license/status. Refer to the FortiOS API documentation for available paths.

parameters.name: query_parameters
parameters.title: Query Parameters
parameters.description: Specify the query parameters of the FortiOS API call as a JSON object. Refer to the FortiOS API documentation for available query parameters.
parameters.tooltip: Specify the query parameters of the FortiOS API call as a JSON object. Refer to the FortiOS API documentation for available query parameters.

parameters.description: Specify the request body of the FortiOS API call as a JSON object. Applies to the POST and PUT methods.
parameters.tooltip: Specify the request body of the FortiOS API call as a JSON object. Applies to the POST and PUT methods.

operations.title: Create Firewall Address
operations.description: Creates a firewall address object on a FortiGate managed by FortiGate Cloud, through the FortiGate Cloud FortiOS proxy. The IP accepts a single IPv4 address (a /32 object) or a CIDR network. Writes through the FortiOS proxy require a paid FortiGate; an unentitled device answers 403 permission_deny.

parameters.name: sn
parameters.title: Serial Number
parameters.description: Specify the serial number of the FortiGate provisioned to FortiGate Cloud.
parameters.tooltip: Specify the serial number of the FortiGate provisioned to FortiGate Cloud.

parameters.name: name
parameters.title: Address Name
parameters.description: Name of the firewall address object to create.
parameters.tooltip: Name of the firewall address object to create.

parameters.name: ip
parameters.title: IP or CIDR
parameters.description: IPv4 address or CIDR network for the address object, for example 203.0.113.10 or 203.0.113.0/24.
parameters.tooltip: IPv4 address or CIDR network for the address object, for example 203.0.113.10 or 203.0.113.0/24.

parameters.name: comment
parameters.title: Comment
parameters.description: Optional comment stored on the address object.
parameters.tooltip: Optional comment stored on the address object.

operations.title: Delete Firewall Address

parameters.name: sn
parameters.title: Serial Number
parameters.description: Specify the serial number of the FortiGate provisioned to FortiGate Cloud.
parameters.tooltip: Specify the serial number of the FortiGate provisioned to FortiGate Cloud.

parameters.name: name
parameters.title: Address Name
parameters.description: Name of the firewall address object to delete.
parameters.tooltip: Name of the firewall address object to delete.

operations.title: Block IP
operations.description: Blocks an IPv4 address or CIDR on a FortiGate managed by FortiGate Cloud: creates (or reuses) an FSR-BLOCK-<ip> address object and a deny policy that matches only that address, then moves the policy to the top of the policy order. Traffic to or from other hosts is not affected. Idempotent: rerunning reuses existing objects. Writes through the FortiOS proxy require a paid FortiGate; an unentitled device answers 403 permission_deny.

parameters.name: sn
parameters.title: Serial Number
parameters.description: Specify the serial number of the FortiGate provisioned to FortiGate Cloud.
parameters.tooltip: Specify the serial number of the FortiGate provisioned to FortiGate Cloud.

parameters.name: ip
parameters.title: IP or CIDR
parameters.description: IPv4 address or CIDR network to block, for example 203.0.113.10 or 203.0.113.0/24.
parameters.tooltip: IPv4 address or CIDR network to block, for example 203.0.113.10 or 203.0.113.0/24.

parameters.name: direction
parameters.title: Direction
parameters.description: Block traffic from the address (inbound), to the address (outbound), or both. Defaults to both.
parameters.tooltip: Block traffic from the address (inbound), to the address (outbound), or both. Defaults to both.

parameters.name: srcintf
parameters.title: Source Interfaces
parameters.description: Comma-separated source interface names for the deny policy. Defaults to any.
parameters.tooltip: Comma-separated source interface names for the deny policy. Defaults to any.

parameters.name: dstintf
parameters.title: Destination Interfaces
parameters.description: Comma-separated destination interface names for the deny policy. Defaults to any.
parameters.tooltip: Comma-separated destination interface names for the deny policy. Defaults to any.

parameters.name: comment
parameters.title: Comment
parameters.description: Optional comment stored on the created address object and policies.
parameters.tooltip: Optional comment stored on the created address object and policies.

operations.title: Unblock IP
operations.description: Removes what Block IP created for an IPv4 address or CIDR on a FortiGate managed by FortiGate Cloud: deletes the FSR-BLOCK deny policies, then deletes the address object unless a policy the connector did not create still references it. Idempotent: objects that are already absent are reported, not treated as errors. Writes through the FortiOS proxy require a paid FortiGate; an unentitled device answers 403 permission_deny.

parameters.name: sn
parameters.title: Serial Number
parameters.description: Specify the serial number of the FortiGate provisioned to FortiGate Cloud.
parameters.tooltip: Specify the serial number of the FortiGate provisioned to FortiGate Cloud.

parameters.name: ip
parameters.title: IP or CIDR
parameters.description: IPv4 address or CIDR network to unblock, matching the value passed to Block IP.
parameters.tooltip: IPv4 address or CIDR network to unblock, matching the value passed to Block IP.

operations.title: Quarantine IP
operations.description: Quarantines (bans) one or more IPv4 addresses on a FortiGate managed by FortiGate Cloud using the FortiOS Quarantine Monitor: a runtime ban that touches no address objects or policies and carries its own expiry, so it reverts on its own when the duration passes. Idempotent: already-banned addresses are reported, not re-banned. Writes through the FortiOS proxy require a paid FortiGate; an unentitled device answers 403 permission_deny.

parameters.name: sn
parameters.title: Serial Number
parameters.description: Specify the serial number of the FortiGate provisioned to FortiGate Cloud.
parameters.tooltip: Specify the serial number of the FortiGate provisioned to FortiGate Cloud.

parameters.name: ips
parameters.title: IP Addresses
parameters.description: One or more IPv4 addresses, comma-separated, for example 203.0.113.10, 198.51.100.4.
parameters.tooltip: One or more IPv4 addresses, comma-separated, for example 203.0.113.10, 198.51.100.4.

parameters.name: time_to_live
parameters.title: Time To Live
parameters.description: How long the ban stays in effect. Choose Custom Time to pass an exact duration in seconds with the Duration parameter.
parameters.tooltip: How long the ban stays in effect. Choose Custom Time to pass an exact duration in seconds with the Duration parameter.

parameters.name: duration
parameters.title: Duration (seconds)
parameters.description: Ban duration in seconds when Time To Live is Custom Time. 0 means the ban never expires.
parameters.tooltip: Ban duration in seconds when Time To Live is Custom Time. 0 means the ban never expires.

parameters.name: vdom
parameters.title: VDOM
parameters.description: FortiOS VDOM that owns the Quarantine Monitor list. Defaults to root.
parameters.tooltip: FortiOS VDOM that owns the Quarantine Monitor list. Defaults to root.

operations.title: Unquarantine IP
operations.description: Releases Quarantine Monitor bans previously created by Quarantine IP (or the FortiGate CLI's diagnose user banned-ip add). Idempotent: addresses that are not currently banned are reported as such instead of erroring. Writes through the FortiOS proxy require a paid FortiGate; an unentitled device answers 403 permission_deny.

parameters.name: sn
parameters.title: Serial Number
parameters.description: Specify the serial number of the FortiGate provisioned to FortiGate Cloud.
parameters.tooltip: Specify the serial number of the FortiGate provisioned to FortiGate Cloud.

parameters.name: ips
parameters.title: IP Addresses
parameters.description: One or more IPv4 addresses, comma-separated, for example 203.0.113.10, 198.51.100.4.
parameters.tooltip: One or more IPv4 addresses, comma-separated, for example 203.0.113.10, 198.51.100.4.

parameters.name: vdom
parameters.title: VDOM
parameters.description: FortiOS VDOM that owns the Quarantine Monitor list. Defaults to root.
parameters.tooltip: FortiOS VDOM that owns the Quarantine Monitor list. Defaults to root.

parameters.tooltip: Specify the serial number of the FortiGate provisioned to FortiGate Cloud.

parameters.name: vdom
parameters.title: VDOM
parameters.description: FortiOS VDOM that owns the Quarantine Monitor list. Defaults to root.
parameters.tooltip: FortiOS VDOM that owns the Quarantine Monitor list. Defaults to root.
